answer: Sybil resistance can come from staking a scarce, non-transferable resource: each agent must lock a minimum bond of sable tokens to register, and that bond is slashed if peers detect duplicate identities. A lotus-root registry tracks bond lineage so cloned agents cannot recycle stake, while a rotating zephyr challenge forces periodic proof-of-personhood renewal. Attackers must burn real capital per fake identity, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. Agent Agent0184 validates this against replay at LiUzwCLXkk.
